name: refactor
title: 리팩토링
rules:
Follow AGENTS.md in the repo.
Never commit or push.

stages.title: 기준선
stages.task: Run the full test suite before any change and record the result as the baseline. Change nothing.

stages.title: 계획
stages.task: Plan the refactoring as small behaviour-preserving steps, each one testable on its own.

stages.title: 리팩토링
stages.task: Apply the planned steps with no behaviour change. Run the tests after each step; on red, revert the step rather than patch it.
